xanadu: n. 華廈,行宮,世外桃源
xanthine:
n. 黃質, 黃嘌呤
[化] 黃嘌呤
n. crystalline oxidation product of the metabolism of nucleoproteins; precursor of uric acid; found in many organs and in urine
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 xanth- ＋ -ine；得名於其與硝酸一起蒸乾時留下的黃色殘渣</dd></dl>
xanthone: n. [化]一種化學原料(為殺蟲劑及合成染料)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 xanth- ＋ -one</dd></dl>
xanthophyll: n yellow carotenoid pigments in plants and animal fats and egg yolks
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">法語 xanthophylle，源自 xanth- ＋ -phylle（英語 -phyll）</dd></dl>
xavier: n. Spanish missionary and Jesuit who establish missionaries in Japan and Ceylon and the East Indies (1506-1552)
